paragraphs.text:
Should you head north? Amidst 
the eons-old streets and cyclopean 
buildings you see a mosaic. It depicts 
the stump-like horrors fleeing 
something, their tentacles flailing as 
they enter the sea. You imagine you 
hear their eldritch screams. To wander 
the streets, go to 548; or to head west, 
go to 549.
(543, 548, 549)
